title: The Pink Christmas Mantel
description: A pink Christmas mantel: a pink cedar garland, knitted stockings, a mini pink tree, pink ornaments and glass taper candlestick holders.
intro: A mantel can carry the whole room at Christmas. This one is all pink: a cedar garland, four knitted stockings, a mini tree, a big set of ornaments and glass candlesticks. Five finds, one Amazon list.

approval.source: Jodie sent the final images in chat and asked for the rest of the system to be finished and scheduled
approval.scope: Publish this Lifestyle article and its supplied images

sections.heading: Garland and stockings first
paragraphs: A 9 foot pink Christmas cedar garland drapes the length of the mantel, and a 4-pack of 18 inch pink knitted stockings with name tags hangs below it.

sections.heading: A little tree, ornaments and candlesticks
paragraphs: A 2 foot pink mini Christmas tree with lights, balls, a bow, a star and a fur skirt sits at one end. A 100-piece set of pink shatterproof ornaments fills a bowl, and a set of six pink glass taper candlestick holders finishes the row.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The five finds are the garland, the stockings, the mini tree, the ornament set and the candlestick holders. The fireplace, mantel, window, rug, presents and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
